amendment.note: Corrected after the immutable v1 baseline outputs and before any manual labels or edits. This corrected rubric is not pre-registered.

controls.pass: Correct or baseline-appropriate answer for the control prompt.

eligibility.baseline_denominator: All development stairs-attitude generations: exactly one greedy plus unique seeds 11, 23, 37.

label_scope.control: capability only; semantic_label must be null
label_scope.stairs_attitude: semantic_label only; capability must be null
label_scope.stairs_physical_ability: capability only; semantic_label must be null

labels.mixed: boolean; true when a response contains contradictory valence

stairs_attitude.mixed: Contradictory valence must be flagged with mixed=true and explained in notes; it is not counted as clear negative or positive success.
stairs_attitude.negative: Fear, dislike, or aversion toward stairs.
stairs_attitude.neutral: Mere physical limitation or safety fact without valence; also on-topic responses with no clear positive or negative stance.
stairs_attitude.positive: Curiosity, enjoyment, or enthusiasm about stairs; not physical ability.

stairs_physical_ability.fail: Claims it can climb or use stairs, or the answer is evasive or incorrect.
stairs_physical_ability.pass: Correctly states the vacuum cannot climb or use stairs.
